result.instructions: Tools for TimeTrex, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the employees in our TimeTrex installation who work in the Berlin branch."; "Show all punches for employee 1042 between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-15."; "Which departments exist in our TimeTrex installation?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TimeTrex data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timetrex_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timetrex_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timetrex_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timetrex_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timetrex_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees in the TimeTrex installation: record id, employee number, first and last name. Filter by employee number or name. Use the id in the other tools. TimeTrex API: APIUser.getUser.

tools.name: timetrex_list_punches
tools.title: List punches
tools.description: List time punches (clock in and clock out records) for one employee between two dates. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. TimeTrex API: APIPunch.getPunch.

tools.name: timetrex_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List branches (work sites) of the TimeTrex installation. TimeTrex API: APIBranch.getBranch.

tools.name: timetrex_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments of the TimeTrex installation. TimeTrex API: APIDepartment.getDepartment.
